description: Wraps content in a configurable bordered box.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: The custom HTML element <tp-box> wraps its content in various ways.

attributes.name: border-radius
attributes.description: Border radius applied to the box. When absent, uses --tp-box-border-radius with a 0px fallback.

attributes.name: border-width
attributes.description: Border width applied to the box. When absent, uses --tp-box-border-width with a 1px fallback.

attributes.name: invert
attributes.description: Uses an inverted surface with contrasting text.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Padding applied inside the box. When absent, uses --tp-box-padding with a 1rem fallback.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-box>` element implements the <tp-icon name="box" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Box functionality: wraps content in a configurable bordered box.
